QuestInfo.name: Checky's Part-Time Job
QuestInfo.0: Checky handed you a flyer, and wanted to talk to you more.
QuestInfo.1: Take Checky's flyer to the Gray milling around in front of the merry-go-round at the #m223010200#.
QuestInfo.2: You took Checky's flyer to the Lost Gray near the merry-go-round.

0.0: Before you head off, I have one more favor to ask. I saw a weird looking fellow when I was working. Did you see that Gray?

yes.0: That Gray is pacing all around. Those big, gooey eyes are weirding me out. You think you could give it a flyer for me?

no.0: Oh, come back when you're less busy.

1.0: Where IS everybody?! Sighhh... Oh, hi there.

yes.0: I don't WANT a flyer... I want to go home!

npc.0: Take this flyer to that Gray.

item.0: That bear-suit-person was looking for you. You must've forgotten something.

lost.0: Here's the flyer. Take it to that alien.
